title: Naming & Stuttering
focus: No stuttering, clear names, receiver consistency, package naming
rules: FixStuttering removes package prefix from type names

flashcards.back: When a type name repeats the package name: http.HTTPClient is stuttering. The correct name is http.Client.

flashcards.front: What is the receiver naming convention?
flashcards.back: Use short, consistent names. The first letter of the type name. Don't use 'this' or 'self'. Use the same name across all methods.

flashcards.front: How should package names relate to directory names?
flashcards.back: They should match. A package in directory 'httputil' should be named 'httputil', not 'utils' or 'helpers'.

flashcards.front: What makes a good Go function name?
flashcards.back: Verb or verb phrase. Short but clear. Avoid 'Get' prefix if the function doesn't fetch. Example: os.Open not os.GetOpen.
